facts.fact: The data protection commission (CDP) says it is working with the Direction de l'automatisation des fichiers (DAF) on integrating civil status and identity, with two options (one integrated system or interoperability) reported to the authorities for decision.

SEN.note: No number at birth is stated.
No operator or maintainer of an ID system is stated.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.
No ID system status is stated.
